name: 34580-imagechat-qwen3vl8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3, driver 570.195.03. The environment seal is configs/env.yaml.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- an 8B bf16 checkpoint and its KV cache fit on one 80 GB card.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=32, warmup 20%, bound 1000 requests, 3600 s safety cap.
workload: single-turn image+text chat: one 1280x720 JPEG plus 1024 text tokens per request, 128 output tokens, temperature 0. Full spec in configs/scenario.json.
purpose: A single-turn visual chat assistant answering photo-plus-text questions with short replies for 32 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# Engine arguments for commit b66a74649e40022c6b1180b98fbb1b6e4b4af74a. The interpreter that runs
# it and the hardware seal are in configs/env.yaml, which is NOT portable.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# 1024 text tokens + the image's prompt tokens + the chat template + 128 generated is ~2.1k.
max-model-len: 4096

# Deliberately ABOVE scenario.json's 32 streams, so the operating point is the stream count.
max-num-seqs: 64

# Must match scenario.json's `images_per_request: 1`: it is both the admission limit and what the
# engine's startup profiling pass is sized against. Change one and you must change both.
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}

gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90

# Every request carries different pixels and different text, so neither cache can hit.
enable-prefix-caching: false
mm-processor-cache-gb: 0
